verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.91
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.91

verses.pali: 10. Asuravagga
verses.english: 10. Titans

verses.pali: Asurasutta
verses.english: Titans

verses.pali: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these four individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Asuro asuraparivāro,
verses.english: A titan surrounded by titans,

verses.pali: asuro devaparivāro,
verses.english: a titan surrounded by gods,

verses.pali: devo asuraparivāro,
verses.english: a god surrounded by titans, and

verses.pali: devo devaparivāro.
verses.english: a god surrounded by gods.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo asuro hoti asuraparivāro?
verses.english: And how is an individual a titan surrounded by titans?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo, parisāpissa hoti dussīlā pāpadhammā.
verses.english: It’s when an individual is unethical, of bad character, and their followers are the same.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo asuro hoti asuraparivāro.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is a titan surrounded by titans.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo asuro hoti devaparivāro?
verses.english: And how is an individual a titan surrounded by gods?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo, parisā ca khvassa hoti sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā.
verses.english: It’s when an individual is unethical, of bad character, but their followers are ethical, of good character.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo asuro hoti devaparivāro.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is a titan surrounded by gods.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo devo hoti asuraparivāro?
verses.english: And how is an individual a god surrounded by titans?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo, parisā ca khvassa hoti dussīlā pāpadhammā.
verses.english: It’s when an individual is ethical, of good character, but their followers are unethical, of bad character.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo devo hoti asuraparivāro.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is a god surrounded by titans.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo devo hoti devaparivāro?
verses.english: And how is an individual a god surrounded by gods?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo, parisāpissa hoti sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā.
verses.english: It’s when an individual is ethical, of good character, and their followers are the same.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo devo hoti, devaparivāro.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is a god surrounded by gods.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the four individuals found in the world.”

verses.pali: Paṭhamaṁ.
